label: Calculator
title: Calculator
subtitle: Exact arithmetic on two numbers — add, subtract, multiply, or divide.
whenToUse: Use this tool for exact arithmetic with integers, decimals, scientific notation, or fractions. Send each input as text, such as "9007199254740993", "0.1", "1.25e-6", or "1/3", so every digit reaches the calculator unchanged. Results are exact: terminating decimals are written in full, and recurring decimals are returned as reduced fractions. Decimal and large-integer results are text so they retain their precision when reused. Numeric inputs are accepted only for safe integers; other numeric inputs produce an error asking for the original value as text. Each input supports up to 10,000 characters and exponents from -10,000 to 10,000; larger inputs produce an error instead of a rounded answer.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Returns the sum of two numbers.

methods.name: Subtract
methods.description: Returns the first number minus the second.

methods.name: Multiply
methods.description: Returns the product of two numbers.

methods.name: Divide
methods.description: Returns the exact quotient, using a reduced fraction such as 1/3 when the decimal never ends. Division by zero produces an error.
